# VST Module Architecture 1.0 interface headers

These Steinberg headers (January 2004), converted from Windows-1252 to UTF-8
with no code changes, are used by the Windows Cubase MIDI Insert. They retain their original
BSD-style license notices; see each header. Include LICENSE.txt with binaries.

Source mirror of the original SDK:
https://web.mit.edu/fustflum/projects/aliquot/vstmodsdk-1.0/

This is the legacy MIDI-FX API. The regular VST3 does not include or link these headers.
